observations: Photo 0 shows a used internal combustion engine with a Bosch EDC16C50ECU (ECU) visible on the top left.
The engine is surrounded by hoses, wiring, and other mechanical components.
The engine block shows signs of dirt and use.
The engine is not installed in a vehicle; it is shown as a standalone unit.
No manufacturer logos, model plates, or identification stickers are clearly legible in the photo.

claims.evidence: The term 'Quality' is subjective and cannot be verified from a photo of a used engine.
While common, this requires a clear photo of the engine identification plate (engine code) to confirm the specific model.
The Sharan is a different vehicle platform; compatibility requires the engine code.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may be a different model (e.g., 1.6L) than the 2.0L claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the side or front of the engine block).

risks.risk: The engine may have internal mechanical damage (e.g., blown head gasket, cracked block) not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running and a photo of the engine block and cylinder head.

risks.risk: The engine may be missing a critical component (e.g., timing belt, water pump).
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with all major components visible.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate (engine code) to confirm the 2.0L specification.
Photo of the engine with all major components visible to check for missing parts.
Video of the engine running to confirm it is functional.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
